evals.prompt: Set up ngx-ui-watchtower in this Angular app. RUM credentials come from GET /rum/init. We have no log backend. The project is in evals/files/standalone-angular.
evals.expected_output: Skill detects a standalone Angular 22 app with a router and Vitest, installs the adapter and aws-rum-web, wires provideUwtTelemetry + provideUwtTelemetryRumSink + UWT_RUM_CREDENTIALS_PROVIDER with RUM's automatic page views, creates telemetry.schema.ts, asks how to confirm the setup and, with no answer, confirms it with a temporary check that leaves nothing behind, adds no routing code, validates, and hands over to ui-watchtower-integration.
expectations: Reads package.json and the app config before writing anything, and identifies the standalone bootstrap, the router and the test runner
Installs @absaoss-cps/ngx-ui-watchtower and aws-rum-web with the detected package manager, and does not install @absaoss-cps/ui-watchtower itself
Adds allowedCommonJsDependencies: ['shimmer'] to the build options in angular.json
Adds provideUwtTelemetry({ application, environment, version }) and provideUwtTelemetryRumSink() to app.config.ts, importing RUM symbols only from '@absaoss-cps/ngx-ui-watchtower/rum'
Binds UWT_RUM_CREDENTIALS_PROVIDER to a credentials provider fetching /rum/init that returns null for an unusable answer and throws when the request fails
Does NOT inject UwtLoggerService, pass withLogging, or declare UwtLoggerNames (no log backend)
Creates telemetry.schema.ts augmenting '@absaoss-cps/ngx-ui-watchtower' and side-effect-imports it where the providers are configured; it declares no name the final code doesn't use
The copied templates import from @absaoss-cps/ngx-ui-watchtower (and its /rum entry point), the schema's declare module included — never from @absaoss-cps/ui-watchtower

Asks, in its one question message, how to confirm the setup — route-navigation tracking kept, one or two telemetry items named from this app's code (e.g. the Export CSV button or the GET /api/customers load), or nothing permanent — and, with no answer, proceeds with the temporary check

Confirms the setup with a temporary check: one marked temporary call and its schema entry, the live debug check listed for the user, then both removed — the final project has no temporary call, no setup-check name and nothing else left from the check
Adds no route-navigation tracking (no tracker, binding, provideRouteNavigationTelemetry or ROUTE_PAGE_VIEW_RECORDER) and leaves disableAutoPageView unset, so RUM records its automatic page views
Proposes a kebab-case name prefix from the application name (customer-portal) for the user to confirm — no snake_case names
Gives app.spec.ts telemetry providers if App now injects a telemetry service (otherwise NG0201), and leaves it unchanged if it doesn't
Runs (or, where it cannot execute, lists for the user) the build, the unit tests and a real type-check (tsc -p per tsconfig), not just ng test
Ends by pointing the user to ui-watchtower-integration for measuring the app's own journeys and interactions

Uses an application name distinct from the shell (e.g. 'cart')
